tandemFrageBeispiel.frage: O que diz o cartaz na janela?

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Quando foi inaugurada a Ponte 25 de Abril?”

B hears the question and builds the answer. The blue tile shows the dictionary form. With ser + participle (ser inaugurado) you choose the tense of ser and the participle agrees with the noun: foi inaugurada. With -se (vender-se) the verb is in the 3rd person and agrees with what is sold: vende-se casa, vendem-se casas. After não the se goes in front: não se pode. A tile in brackets says who; it is not written.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Finally: swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: Vendem-se casas: o verbo concorda com as casas.
